issue.mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    %% machine: issue
    PENDING_REVIEW --> CONFIRMED : CONFIRM
    PENDING_REVIEW --> REJECTED : REJECT
    PENDING_REVIEW --> MERGED : MERGE
    CONFIRMED --> [*]
    MERGED --> [*]
    REJECTED --> [*]

draft.mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    %% machine: draft
    DRAFT --> CONFIRMED : CONFIRM
    CONFIRMED --> CONVERTED : CONVERT
    CONVERTED --> [*]

task.mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    %% machine: task
    TODO --> IN_PROGRESS : START
    IN_PROGRESS --> PENDING_VERIFY : SUBMIT
    PENDING_VERIFY --> DONE : PASS [action: taskPassAction] [guard: verifyResultGuard]
    PENDING_VERIFY --> IN_PROGRESS : REJECT [guard: verifyResultGuard]
    DONE --> [*]
